verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Blink lets you save hosts and keys locally (docs-11, docs-12), but no item documents syncing them across devices via iCloud or any other mechanism. The only on-topic community item is a user asking for config sync because syncing host lists across iOS devices is painful (comm-9), which points to the capability being absent. Cross-device sync is a fair axis for a multi-device SSH client, so the lack of evidence yields "none", not "na".
